choices.reasoning: Hand has Energy (2 energy) for resourcing, cheap support and upgrade, an ally and event. Playable early; keeping it.
Play Heroic Intuition (2 energy) using the Energy card, which pays it exactly. It gives the hero +1 THW for later turns.
Pay with the Energy card (2 energy) to play Heroic Intuition. Daredevil and Interrogation Room cannot be afforded this turn otherwise, and this keeps the ally and support in hand.

Play Daredevil now (4 physical-equivalent cost) using For Justice, Webbed Up, Interrogation Room and Peter's mental ability. It is the only way to get the ally into play this turn, and the board is calm in round 1. The hand refills to 6 at end of turn.

Attack Rhino with Daredevil for 2. I am in alter-ego form, so the villain phase is a scheme, not an attack; the threat is only 1 per round plus Rhino's SCH 1, far from the threshold of 7. Daredevil takes 1 consequential damage and survives.

Change to Spider-Man (hero form) so the hero can attack Rhino this turn. Rhino's ATK of 2 plus a boost card is survivable at 10 HP, and Daredevil is exhausted so the hero can take the hit. Hero form also stops the villain from scheming, which is safe here.
Basic attack Rhino for 2 with Spider-Man. Rhino goes to 10 HP. Spider-Man exhausts, so he cannot defend this villain phase; Rhino's attack of 2 plus boost is survivable at 10 HP.
Do not defend. Spider-Man at 10 HP can absorb Rhino's ATK 2 plus boost. Using Daredevil (2 HP left) would kill it, and Spider-Man's DEF would cost next turn's attack.
Do not defend. Losing Daredevil to a 2-damage hit is worse than Spider-Man taking 2 damage and a stun. Spider-Man stays at 6 HP and the stun only costs one attack.
Play Mockingbird (3 physical) paid with Strength and Power of Justice. Her enter-play stun on Rhino blocks Rhino's next attack, protecting Spider-Man and Daredevil this villain phase.
Pay with The Power of Justice and Strength (3 physical-compatible). This keeps the mental cards for Swinging Web Kick and Nick Fury.

choices.reasoning: Swinging Web Kick deals 8 to Rhino (10 HP), leaving 2. Then Daredevil's attack finishes it.
Stun is gone, so Spider-Man's basic attack goes through for 2. Rhino is stunned, so spending Spider-Man's defense this turn costs little.
Daredevil attacks Rhino for 2 (8 to 6). It takes 1 consequential damage, leaving it at 1 HP. Rhino is stunned, so the next villain attack is cancelled.
Mockingbird attacks Rhino for 1 (6 to 5). She takes 1 consequential damage and survives at 2 HP. Strategy says use every ready ally.
End turn in hero form. Rhino's stunned attack is cancelled, threat is low, and no other enemies are in play.
Enhanced Spider-Sense cancels Caught Off Guard's When Revealed, so I keep Heroic Intuition in play.
Pay with Avengers Mansion (mental). Surveillance Team is more useful for removing threat, so I keep it.
Spider-Man basic attack for 2 (Rhino 5 to 3). Part of an exact 5-damage lethal sequence with Daredevil and Mockingbird.
Mockingbird attacks Rhino for 1 (3 to 2). Sets up Daredevil's 2 to finish the stage.
Daredevil deals 2 to Rhino (2 HP) to defeat stage 1. It will be defeated by its own consequential damage, but it has only 1 HP and would die to any attack anyway.

Keep Backflip for the free interrupt that prevents all damage from Rhino's attack. Surveillance Team would cost both Backflip and Webbed Up. Stay in hero form so Rhino attacks rather than schemes. Threat is 2 of 7, so the coming villain phase is not dangerous.
Discard nothing. Keep Backflip, Webbed Up and Surveillance Team, and draw up to 5.
Do not defend. Backflip will prevent all damage from this attack as an interrupt, so Spider-Man stays ready for next turn.
Play Backflip to prevent all 5 damage from Rhino's attack, keeping Spider-Man at 6 HP.
Defend with Mockingbird (1 HP). She is nearly defeated anyway, and taking Vulture's 3+ ATK at 6 HP risks defeat. Defending with Spider-Man would exhaust him for my next turn.

Play Jessica Jones (3 ATK-equivalent cost) by discarding Webbed Up, Surveillance Team and Backflip. Together with Spider-Man's attack she kills Vulture (4 HP), removing one of three attackers. Both heroes ready before the villain phase to defend.
Jessica Jones attacks Vulture for 2 (4 to 2). She takes 1 consequential damage. Spider-Man follows up to finish it.
Spider-Man attacks Vulture for 2 (2 to 0), defeating it.
No ready card or action remains that helps, and staying in hero form keeps threat (3, plus about 2 this round) below the target of 7. Alter-ego would let Sandman and Rhino scheme past the target.
Defend with Spider-Man. DEF 3 reduces Rhino's base 3 ATK to 0, so only the boost icons get through. Taking the full hit at 6 HP could defeat me if the boost is high.

Defend with Jessica Jones. She will be defeated by Sandman's 3 damage, but taking it at 6 HP with an unknown boost could defeat Spider-Man, and that loses the whole game. Keeping hit points matters more than the ally.
